question.text: In forced oscillation of a particle the amplitude is maximum for a frequency $\omega_1$ of the force, while the energy is maximum for a frequency $\omega_2$ of the force, then

options.text: $\omega_1 < \omega_2$ when damping is small and $\omega_1>\omega_2$ when damping is large

solution.text:
Both amplitude and energy get maximised when the frequency is equal to the natural frequency. This is the condition of resonance.
$$
\omega_1=\omega_2
$$
